sloka: ऋक्षा: पृषतसङ्घाश्च रुरवश्च समतन्त: ।दृश्यन्ते वनराजीषु गिरिष्वपि नदीषु च ॥ २.९३.२॥
transliteration: ṛkṣā: pṛṣatasaṅghāśca ruravaśca samatanta: ।dṛśyante vanarājīṣu giriṣvapi nadīṣu ca ॥ 2.93.2॥

translations.english: Bears, herds of dappled gazelle and antelopes could be seen everywhere in the stretches of the forest, also on the mountains and on the river banks.
